newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Huarte adds capital in financial overhaul.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Huarte adds capital in financial overhaul.

text.p: Shareholders of Spanish construction firm Huarte approved on Tuesday an increase in the company's share capital by 2.1 billion pesetas in exchange for previous debt, a local news agency said.

The troubled construction firm said it was a step toward a global financial overhaul of the company. Huarte chairman Rafael Fernandez told shareholders the capital increase was needed to grant shares to debt-holders who had agreed to the exchange.
Huarte shares rose 31 pesetas to 239 on Tuesday.
